boardName: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board

connectionTypes.verifiedByNote: The slum-concession rate (₹7/KL on the 0-15 KL slab, with a lower ₹105 minimum on ½" slum connections) is NOT modeled here — this file covers the standard (non-slum) domestic tariff only. A secondary source's claim of a '20 KL free' domestic scheme is NOT reflected here: the primary 2011 board order shows no such free allowance for standard domestic connections, only the slum concessional rate, so that claim is treated as unverified/likely incorrect rather than included.

verifiedBy: SOURCED (primary, official) — HMWSSB Board Proceedings No. 136, dated 10.11.2011, effective 01.12.2011, fetched directly from the board's own official site (hyderabadwater.gov.in). This is the board's last COMPREHENSIVE tariff revision — old (2011) but confirmed still current: a September 2025 Telangana Today report on a proposed sewerage-cess hike describes it as coming 'after a 14-year gap', confirming no revision has actually been implemented since 2011 despite a pending unfinalized proposal. Above 200 KL/month, the entire consumption is billed at a flat ₹40/KL rather than telescoped (modeled via flatRateAboveKL, not approximated). 35% sewerage cess is added on top of water charges per the same order. The pipe-size figures are correctly modeled as a MINIMUM charge (fixedChargeMode: minimumFloor) — collected only when it exceeds the computed water+sewerage total, per the order's own wording ('minimum charge... in case monthly tariff/consumption... is less than minimum charges'), not added on top of it. Commercial/industrial tariffs not yet sourced — domestic only.
